19871.ins: Two-piece maid sets live in the wash cycle rather than the costume box - light enough to launder after every wear, small enough to store in a drawer corner. Chiffon dries on a hanger overnight, which keeps the set in rotation rather than in retirement.
19871.short: Two-piece chiffon maid set with outfit and matching underwear, one size for 40-60 kg, low-commitment role-play lingerie as pictured.

19878.ins: Blue and red split the school-uniform reference cleanly: blue is the classic, red is the departure. The top and panties pack flat, which makes this the travel costume for weekends where a theme is on the itinerary but luggage space is not.
19878.short: School uniform miniskirt set with top and matching panties in red or blue polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece costume.

19888.ins: A complete-set purchase removes the improvisation from catgirl costumes - the pieces that usually get improvised are the ears and the tail, and improvised ones never match. Polyester in as-pictured colorway, cold wash, flat dry, repeat.
19888.short: Playful polyester catgirl costume sold as one complete split set with coordinated pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

19900.ins: Printed per-size measurements are the rarest feature in costume listings and the most useful: M through XL each carry their own bust, waist, and length figures. The tail is sewn to the teddy, so it survives the wash and the night equally.
19900.short: Black rabbit-tail teddy with sleeves in three measured sizes M to XL, per-size bust and length specs, 40-65 kg by chart.

19907.ins: Red chiffon at Halloween is the alternative to the black-everything default, and the headgear horns hold their shape in a bag between wears. The neck ring is soft enough to forget about, which is the test most costume neckwear fails.
19907.short: Red chiffon little devil set with horned headgear, neck ring and jumpsuit, three pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

19925.ins: Laser-finish patent leather is the most light-reactive surface in the costume category - what reads subtle in daylight turns vivid under party lighting, worth knowing before choosing this over flat patent. The leather socks match, which is the set's quiet convenience.
19925.short: Laser patent leather one-piece with jumpsuit, leather socks and headwear, waist 60-88 cm range, one size for 40-55 kg.

19930.ins: Clothing-only listings suit buyers with a drawer full of maid accessories already - this is the dress to replace the one that wore out, not the starter kit. Blue or pink in the same cut; gentle wash keeps the sweetheart line sitting where it should.
19930.short: Sweetheart-neckline maid set in blue or pink polyester, clothing only, one size for 40-60 kg, role-play costume without accessories.

19932.ins: A single-garment nun costume is the most practical format in the category - nothing to assemble, nothing to lose, and the read lands instantly. Black polyester washes cold and dries hung, and the habit keeps its drape through repeated wear.
19932.short: Black polyester nun habit costume in one piece with authority-figure styling, one size for 40-60 kg, no accessories needed.

19938.ins: The bust range runs 80-120 cm, the widest in the bridal category and printed for checking - bridal sets usually hide their limits until the zipping moment. The headscarf doubles as a hair piece for photographs where a full veil would be too much.
19938.short: White lace bridal set with headscarf, outfit, underwear and bracelet, bust 80-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg, four pieces.

19944.ins: Five pieces is the complete flight attendant kit on this site - the four-piece versions drop the scarf, and the scarf is the piece that carries the fantasy. Blue polyester keeps its color through a season of gentle washes and one very long layover.
19944.short: Blue polyester flight attendant set with hat, scarf, top, short skirt and thong, five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.
